en-US.longDescription:
ht-cli drives the HostTracker API v2 REST surface from a shell.
Every operation of the API is a command: monitors, contacts, alerts,
reports, incidents, maintenance windows, status pages, webhooks and
on-demand checks, with JSON, YAML and table output and an exit code
per failure class.
en-US.name: ht-cli
